Specification: This specification models a very small counter system used to validate or inspect TLC runtime metadata during simulation or trace generation. It has a single variable x, initializes x to 0, and increments x by 1 on each Next step while asserting expectations about values returned by TLCGet for configuration, statistics, and revision information, and invoking TLCSet to request exit when x = 4223. The temporal behavior is given by Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_x, and the file mainly serves as a TLC-oriented harness rather than a distributed algorithm or fault-tolerant protocol.
